title: ISO 17485:2006 — Bevel gears — ISO system of accuracy
locator: Official catalogue abstract: geometric accuracy classification for unassembled bevel gears, hypoid gears and gear pairs; review status and scope exclusions
notes: Applies to specified unassembled bevel/hypoid gears and gear pairs. It expressly excludes enclosed gear-unit assemblies such as reducers and warns that loose-gear accuracy grades do not directly predict assembled performance. The standard is under revision; check the current project before contractual use. Full text is not archived.
